inspected_for_planning.scope: 공통 바닥과 기본 입체, 상단 좌·우 직교 경계 방향과 기능 출구 하나씩, 상태에 맞는 접근 및 개방 후 연결 동선, 높이 상한. 각 면 중앙·중간·끝 위치와 출구 형태 가변; 건물 입구 겸용 가능

note: The inspected and submitted lists are separate current records. Exact input order/count/path/hash must match tool_arguments.json. Every requirement links to submitted reference IDs or a current text-only reason. Role preservation review covers geometry, art, world, surface and architecture form without requiring one input per role. Do not make art/world reference removal the default geometry fix. A local copied comparison-only image retains its source restrictions by hash. Recent mode may contain conversation-only entries with path/sha256 null and explicit conversation_image_evidence. A user-requested catalog-image edit is role edit_target with current request source/quote/evidence, never a source overwrite or master promotion.

reference_role_mapping.role_balance_and_selection_reason: 실패 투영이 반복된 생성결과를 입력하지 않고 현재 정사영가이드와 원래 LDI/world/brush/form 역할 4장을 유지하여 재구성; 이전 결과는 QA 비교만.
reference_role_mapping.camera_rule: Final orthographic projection is mandatory and overrides every reference camera including M01. M01/M02 structure informs base/framing/connectivity; art/world images supply only approved aspects and exclude camera/layout.
reference_role_mapping.ldi_supplement_scope: M03-11~15: architecture/materials/lighting/color only; exclude nature, world/story, characters, vehicles, camera/layout, UI/text and source shop identity. M03-12: building only, excluding trees/grass/forest/natural ground. This is not a project-wide vegetation ban.
reference_role_mapping.user_added_reference_scope: M03-16: architectural masses/color/value/material simplification only, not confirmed LDI; exclude source camera/world/layout. M04-08: varied retro casings/analog controls/modular joins, adapted to Salvage Cyberpunk and Master03 finish; retain existing green-CRT exclusion. Named selections apply to the current request without promoting global defaults. M03-17: architectural proportions, roof silhouettes, faded color planes and selective paint peeling only; exclude source perspective, vertical overcrowding and coastal scene content. Main building placement and straight structure share common XY, with permitted ground-level curves under v2.8; square-base/orthographic/roof-support requirements remain mandatory.
reference_role_mapping.surface_style_scope: Master03 v2.3: broad clean base-color planes plus sparse broad directional flat nearby-tone brushwork, also on intact areas and separate from damage. M03-10 stays representative. B03-01 may be selected for surface-only support; B03-02/03/04 are comparison-only, not automatic generation inputs. Do not transfer their camera/layout/night/palette or promote geometry. Record actual submitted images and roles only.

F01_to_F07.scope: Selected large silhouette, facade depth, additions and architectural/equipment relationships only; choose by current scene and record actual input index.
F01_to_F07.source_authorship: unconfirmed; do not classify as LDI

F08_to_F11.scope: Comparison of approved form traits only. Preserve source image/review and do not inherit projection, layout, route occlusion, quantitative ratio or full-image approval.
F08_to_F11.later_explicit_request: A later user-specified edit/reference is a separate scoped request; this comparison approval does not authorize submission.

architecture_form_scope.preserve_roles: Keep core masters27, surface support4 and architecture groups separate; do not submit all7 or drop01/02,03,04 roles to make room.

omitted_references_and_reasons.reason: 실제 열람. M02의 공간도해와 텍스트 기단/투영 설계가 공간 역할을 담당하도록 하고 제한된 선택 묶음에서 붓표현과 형태 자료를 각각 확보. M01은 전달하지 않음.
직접 열람한 M02의 두 경계/출구 구조를 현재 장면 정사영 가이드로 구체화하여 제출
